# Material Symbols Rounded

`ic_replay_10.xml`, `ic_forward_10.xml`, `ic_lock.xml` and `ic_lock_open.xml` are Material Symbols Rounded
icons from Google, licensed under Apache License 2.0. The license is included
in `material-symbols-LICENSE.txt`.

Sources:

- https://github.com/google/material-design-icons/blob/master/symbols/android/lock/materialsymbolsrounded/lock_24px.xml
- https://github.com/google/material-design-icons/blob/master/symbols/android/lock_open/materialsymbolsrounded/lock_open_24px.xml

- https://github.com/google/material-design-icons/blob/master/symbols/android/replay_10/materialsymbolsrounded/replay_10_24px.xml
- https://github.com/google/material-design-icons/blob/master/symbols/android/forward_10/materialsymbolsrounded/forward_10_24px.xml
